d:
Rahul ne pichhle hafte yunivarsiti of shikago men ek batchit ke dauran rannitik hiton ko dekhte hue israil ke sath mazbut sanbandhon ka samarthan kiya tha. halanki, rahul gandhi ki is tippani ko kangres ke purane rukh men narmi ke sanket ke taur par dekha ja raha hai. israil par rahul gandhi ke haliya bayan ki unke sahyogi dalon ne bhi aalochna ki hai. iski vajah kya hai?
Riport: rajnish kumar
Editing: altaf
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
